regions.merged_text: Ex. "Life of Pius X" Leo XIII 1878 "I must address the s. college. I fear they are about to commit a grave mistake. People think I am a learned man --- wisdom" (Resp. of a fellow Cardinal) "As to your learning, we, not you can best judge of that. As to your qualifications for the pon- tifical office, God knows what they are. Leave it all to Him." "The social problem is not a question of charity or of donations but a question of right, and of right, and of fundamental Christian justice." Leo XIII "It must be carefully observed -- only the Church of Jesus Christ has been able to preserve and surely will preserve to the sonsummation of time her form of government."- idem.
